_comment: Employer tiering. Names are matched after normalisation (case, punctuation and suffixes like Ltd/PLC/GmbH ignored). Exact names win over patterns; the first matching pattern wins. Size bands follow the UK Companies Act: small < 50 staff, medium 50-249, large 250+. Anything unmatched is Tier 3 with size inferred from the advert text, else 'unknown'. Extend freely.

tier_definitions.1: Market leaders and major institutions: FTSE 100 / Fortune Global 500, big tech, Big 4 and Magic Circle firms, global banks, NHS trusts and health boards, Russell Group and top European universities, central government and EU institutions.
tier_definitions.2: Established mid-to-large organisations: FTSE 250 and well-known scale-ups, other universities and research institutes, local councils, police and fire services, large housing associations and charities, multi-academy trusts.
tier_definitions.3: SMEs, start-ups, independent schools and academies, small charities, GP practices, care providers and all other licensed sponsors.
